notes_for_editor: Only index and list sources were found; no tower-specific history was read. The FFLA says Tower Gone. The place listing still names the tower, but it is a place entry, so it is not evidence that a structure stands. The Forest Lookouts index has no page of its own for Smart School that could be reached from the cache. A Portal to Texas History search for "Smart School" "fire tower" returned six items (Silsbee Bee issues 1956-1969 and a Polk County Enterprise issue, 1960); the item pages were not read. Item IDs for a follow-up: metapth763435, metapth767034, metapth771010, metapth776838 (Silsbee Bee, February 16, 1967, page 1 OCR checked and without the phrase), metapth778746, metapth789322. The record's agency is filled from the Forest Lookouts index and tnlandforms. No photos added. Confidence low.
